caption: The video captures a stationary dark-colored SUV parked on wet asphalt, its body fire-damaged with blackened panels and a wide white foam patch on the side doors. A white pickup truck sits motionless behind, and a red hose lies along the bottom-left edge. Smoke or steam vents continuously from the vehicle, rising from the outset. A vertical plume climbs from the roofline above the rear window, its thickness and outline fluctuating. A broader, lower cloud billows around the mid-to-lower side near the rear door and wheel arch, drifting and reshaping. The charred surfaces and white deposits stay fixed as the roof plume thins and the side cloud spreads slightly. The framing remains consistent as venting continues.
relations: Smoke vents continuously from the damaged SUV, rising from the roofline and side.
The roof plume fluctuates in thickness and outline as venting persists.
A lower side cloud billows and spreads slightly near the rear door and wheel arch.
Charred panels and the white foam patch stay fixed while smoke drifts and the framing holds.
